sanskrit_verse:
सापदेशं हरन् कालमब्रुवंश्चापि संसदि।
उक्त्वा वचो विब्रुवंश्च हीयमानस्य लक्षणम्॥
transliteration: sāpadeśaṃ haran kālam abruvaṃś cāpi saṃsadi | uktvā vaco vibruvaṃś ca hīyamānasya lakṣaṇam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who appropriates time during discourse, remains silent when required to speak in assembly, speaks after uttering irrelevant words, and disrupts the natural sequence of communication—such conduct is symptomatic of a diminished state of consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through alignment with sequential dharma-vakya
Causation arises from disruption of communicative integrity
Capacity-based responsibility is measured by one's ability to maintain conscious participation
Restoration logic demands realignment with the rhythm of satyic expression
Consciousness alignment requires purification of speech patterns
executable_legal_axioms: IF participant interrupts sequential discourse THEN initiate completion process for disrupted speaker
IF individual remains silent during mandatory verbal engagement THEN assign prana-shuddhi protocol
IF speaker utters irrelevant statements causing temporal displacement THEN enforce vak-samyama restoration cycle
IF disruption occurs in collective deliberation THEN invoke sangha-reintegration mechanism
IF repeated violation observed THEN activate antahkarana-shodhana module until stabilized
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court proceedings, any act that distorts the flow of dharmic inquiry—including untimely silence, irrelevant speech, or chronological misalignment—must be addressed not as misconduct but as a symptom requiring immediate consciousness recalibration. The court operates under sequential manifestation logic; hence, disruption implies deviation from satyic capacity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causal link between disrupted vak-yoga and lowered consciousness. Anupūrvaśaḥ indicates sequential degradation due to failure in maintaining śabda-pramāṇa. Proportional responsibility lies in restoring sequential integrity rather than assigning fault. Non-punitive reality rule affirms that correction restores participation capacity without inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Enforce mouna-vyavastha before further public discourse eligibility
Activate guru-guided pratyāhāra for sensory-speech coordination
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law executes pure consciousness order. Justice serves only restoration, never punishment. Reality aligns through awakened speech. Dharma is restored.
